priorityList: Maintain Lightning Shield, Thunderstrike Ward, and Flametongue Weapon at all times.
Cast Stormkeeper if Ascendance has more than 10 seconds remaining on cooldown or is ready to use.
Use Ancestral Swiftness and Nature's Swiftness on cooldown.
Cast Ascendance if Stormkeeper is on cooldown for at least 15 seconds.
Refresh Flame Shock (or use Voltaic Blaze) if the DoT is expiring, but only if Master of the Elements is not active.
Cast Lava Burst to consume Lava Surge procs or generate Maelstrom when Master of the Elements is not active.
Cast Tempest while the Master of the Elements buff is active to maximize damage.
Cast Lightning Bolt to consume Stormkeeper stacks, prioritizing windows where Master of the Elements is active.
Spend Maelstrom on Elemental Blast as your primary spender.
Spend Maelstrom on Earth Shock if Elemental Blast is not available.
Cast Tempest whenever it becomes available if you do not have a Master of the Elements buff to use it on.
Use Lightning Bolt as your primary filler for Maelstrom generation.
While moving, use Flame Shock, Voltaic Blaze, or Frost Shock if no instant casts are available.
Sync offensive trinkets and racial abilities with your Ascendance windows or when Stormkeeper is on cooldown.
